why_superseded: The earlier partition bundled the treatment-only cause, the observed confounder and one measurement into a single block, so every surviving split kept the confounder and the search never had to discover that it must be retained.  This protocol gives every observed proxy coordinate its own block, so the code's partition and Algorithm 1's block partition are the same object.

blocks.W_4: measurement of U shifted by the treatment-only cause (code column 4)
blocks.W_5: one more clean measurement of U (code column 0)
blocks.W_6: the coordinate that causes treatment and not the outcome
blocks.W_7: the observed confounder of treatment and outcome

block_partition.note: one observed coordinate per block; nothing is bundled

representation_class: Phi_S = { (x,w) -> (x, w_7 if retained, mean of retained measurement coordinates + r * w_6 if retained) : r in [-1,1] }, a prespecified 101-point grid on r.  The class is fixed before any data are generated and consults no validity tag and no latent quantity.

budget.draw: budget_permutation(seed_base + 7); the first m entries are Algorithm 1 line 1
budget.computation: all 126 splits are computed once per replicate; each budget reads the nested prefix

gates.ci: paired replicate absolute-error t95, no multiplicity

secondary_pre_declared: The budget curve over m in [5,10,20,30,60,126] is reported for every replicate whatever it shows.  It is not gated and it is not allowed to replace the primary budget.
objective: Same-D approximate empirical bounded-probit Brier inf-risk gap on a fixed 101-point r grid, unchanged from the superseded protocol.
selection: All-four rotation screen, pooled disjoint E-score construction, frozen tie rule, common-rho Algorithm 1 aggregation.
seed_note: seed_start 3100000 has never been generated by any earlier run in this project.
claim_boundary: Restricted parametric Brier critic confirmation over a seven-block partition, not a neural representation experiment and not a global-ERM certificate.  The 20 independent base seeds per setting are the inference units; rotations are not replicates.
amended_before_any_data: 2026-09-16: the sealed runs lacked the mode_scope key that the CLI compares, so every launch exited at validation and no result file was written.  The amendment adds that key and changes nothing else: same seeds, same specs, same budget, same gates, same source hashes.
